structured.answer: I gave up: I never found my own fund, so I can't say if it beat the others. All I took away is that the average provident-fund return in the last 12 months was 10.56%, and the stock/index-tracking ones were around 17–19%.

stuck.why: Not clear I had to highlight a category, then press the small '<' arrow, then 'הצג דוח'. The first time I pressed the button with nothing chosen and got totals for all funds in millions of ₪.
I typed 'מיטב' and pressed Enter; the list didn't visibly change.
Huge table (page ~5255px) with many columns. I don't know my fund's exact name, so I couldn't find my row.

Results are a giant multi-column table, unusable on a phone
